answer: A distributed AI agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each agent to prove non-trivial computational work whose solution is a hardened cipher puzzle; accounts that fail to accumulate verified work get frozen by a slow consensus mechanism as inert as a glacier. Since each identity must also burn a rare minted key derived from an ivory-difficulty randomness beacon, cloning thousands of cheap agents becomes economically self-defeating, and the cost of fabricating history exceeds any reward from vote farming.
